description: Eryonos Corvenorides wears a purple long open-front outer coat with richly woven gold geometric and floral borders. An ivory long linen undertunic has matching purple-gold trim at the neckline, cuffs, central front and hem. A decorated belt with a large round geometric medallion buckle and hanging ornaments secures it. A matching purple-gold shoulder drape with fringed lower end is pinned by a round brooch. Brown leather boots and a finger ring complete the outfit. His wavy dark hair is uncovered.
